A patch release that keeps agent-blocked work out of the ready list.

## Fixes

- **`agent:blocked` issues show Blocked, not Ready.** An issue that an agent stopped on shows **Blocked** instead of **Ready** and leaves **Ready to start**, the ready count and `status:ready`, in both the `agent:blocked` and `agent/blocked` forms. Blocked takes precedence over Spec, Map and In progress. ([#107](https://github.com/brunoorsolon/forge-desk/issues/107))

## Upgrading from 2.0.1

Nothing to change.
